question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
-- Final answer: states where both M and F have retention_rate > 0 at all 6 intervals
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start::DATE AS first_term_start, lt.state
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT 0 AS year_interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,
        l.gender,
        ft.first_term_start,
        i.year_interval,
        (date_trunc('year', ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL (i.year_interval || ' years'))::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS target_dec31,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= (date_trunc('year', ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL (i.year_interval || ' years'))::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= (date_trunc('year', ft.first_term_start + INTERVAL (i.year_interval || ' years'))::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
    FROM first_terms ft
    JOIN legislators l ON ft.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT state, gender, year_interval, 
           COUNT(*) as total,
           SUM(retained) as retained_count,
           1.0 * SUM(retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_interval
),
states_with_positive_all AS (
    SELECT state, gender
    FROM state_gender_retention
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING MIN(retention_rate) > 0
),
qualifying_states AS (
    SELECT state FROM states_with_positive_all
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gender) = 2
)
SELECT state FROM qualifying_states ORDER BY state
